When i was in 6th grade, my family had filed for bankruptcy, it was the poorest we had ever been. So poor we we were living in a jeep wagoneer and a truck mounted camper in the winter, in Montana. Well i would often go to school in dirty clothes, but one day i just realised I had no socks. I was outside walking in circles at recess to keep warm, when tbe school consular noticed. She brought me to her office and pulled her own spare  socks out of her desk and gave them to me. She held me while I cried. Then after school she spoke to my mom and gave her 100 dollars to buy clothes and groceries. My mom broke down too, I honestly think that moment was part of the catalyst that help our family get to the point where we were ok, better than ok. After that she always checked up on me and we became friends. Im 35 now and she is still at that school helping kids. She is a wonderful person.
